events.body:
## Context

`website/templates/includes/header.html` is on every page. Several buttons contain only a Font Awesome icon, so screen readers announce them as just "button".

## What to do

1. In `header.html`: add `aria-label` to the search submit (about L669), `#notificationButton` (about L753) and the `organizations-btn` dropdown (about L672, its text is hidden on mobile). Use `{% trans %}` for the labels.
2. Add `aria-hidden="true"` to the decorative `<i>` icons.
3. Add `aria-haspopup` and toggle `aria-expanded` on `organizations-btn` in the existing dropdown JS (the mega-menu button at L28 already does this; copy it).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The search, notification and organisations buttons have accessible names
- [ ] Decorative icons are `aria-hidden`
- [ ] `aria-expanded` follows the dropdown state
- [ ] Lighthouse "Buttons have an accessible name" passes on the home page

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-core && uv sync && uv run python manage.py runserver   # then check the header in DevTools > Accessibility
```

---
